contents: Received my MS degree from Dongguk University, advised by Prof. Yunsick Sung.
Presented CoMIDI, a MIDI generation service built on MIDILM, in the demo session at KSMI 2026. MidiFill was also presented at KSMI 2026.
Few-shot LoRA Tuning for Genre-Specific Music Generation published in Complex & Intelligent Systems.
MIDILM: A Dual-Path Model for Controllable Text-to-MIDI Generation accepted to AAAI 2026 (Main Track)! 🎉
Filed two patents on symbolic music generation based on the MIDILM research (KR 10-2025-0139998, 10-2025-0139997).
Team MIDILM exhibited and presented our natural-language MIDI generation framework at the 2025 AI Festa (COEX Hall A), as one of 29 exhibiting teams.
Selected as a Top-100 team (of 630) in the AI Champion Program hosted by the Ministry of Science and ICT! 🏆
PixTention: Dynamic Pixel-level Adapter using Attention Maps published in Image and Vision Computing (IVC).
Enhanced BLIP-2 Optimization Using LoRA for Generating Dashcam Captions published in Applied Sciences.
Started serving as a reviewer for EAAI (Elsevier) and IEEE TCSVT.
LoRA Fusion: Enhancing Image Generation published in Mathematics.
Filed a patent (KR 10-2024-0118146) and registered a software copyright (C-2024-026547) for the LLM-based Information Retrieval and QA System.
Started my MS at Dongguk University (Large Multimodal Model Lab), advised by Prof. Yunsick Sung.
Won the Dean's Award at the 2023 Winter ICIP & Capstone Design (Dongguk University) with the local LLM persona NPC project. 🏆
Won the Excellence Award at the 2023 SKT Corporate Capstone Design with the SKT AI BLOG project. 🏆
